# Evan Meyerson appears on the "Financially Legal" podcast


November 13, 2024


-
-
-
-


Managing Director[Evan Meyerson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/evan-meyerson/) appears on the Financially Legal podcast where he discusses "the rapidly evolving world of legal finance," and "dives into different funding models, from single-case to portfolio financing, each designed to support firms with varying needs."
